title: Understanding the Sigmoid Function
text: The sigmoid function, often used in logistic regression, outputs values between $$0$$ and $$1$$. It is defined as $$\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$, where $$z$$ is a linear combination of input features. Consider how this function behaves as $$z$$ approaches positive or negative $$\infty$$.
